fields.meta_title: Click Through Landing Page Examples and Builder | Emergent
fields.meta_description: See 4 click through landing page examples, then build one that sends warmed-up visitors to your checkout or signup. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a Click Through Landing Page That Hands Off to Checkout
fields.hero_description: Build a click through landing page with one button that opens your checkout or signup with the visitor's choice already made.
fields.features_heading: What the Button Carries to the Next Page
fields.features_subheading: A click through landing page explains the offer, then one button opens the page where the visitor buys or signs up.
fields.feature_1:
Describe the offer, get the page

Tell Emergent what you sell and where the button should go. It builds the page with that destination already linked, and you change the copy or the link later by prompting.
fields.feature_2:
The link carries the visitor's choice

Ask for the visitor's chosen plan or item to ride in the button's link. The checkout or signup then opens with it already picked, and nobody chooses the same thing twice.
fields.feature_3:
Campaign tags pass to the next page

Ask the page to pass the campaign tags in its own address on to the next page. The signup record then names the email, post, or partner link that sent each visitor there.
fields.feature_4:
Clicks counted for each button

Each button logs its clicks to a database you own, with the time and the section it sits in. You see which placement sends people on, not one total for the whole page.
fields.feature_5:
Prices read from your own checkout

The app links to the checkout or signup page you already run. It can pull plans and prices from that system through its API, and the page shows what the checkout shows.
fields.feature_6:
Your code, in your GitHub repository

On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository. The page and the database behind its click log leave with it, and any developer can keep working on it from there.

fields.tab_content_1:
261 clicks reached a signup with the Team plan picked

Brinlow sells shift scheduling to restaurants. Its page shows the week view a manager would use, then one Start free trial button. The link opens Brinlow's signup with the Team plan already chosen and the email campaign's tags attached. Of the 1,450 visitors on the page this week, 261 clicked through to that signup.
fields.tab_content_2:
Buyers read March before they see $249

Arc headphones ship in March, and Kestrel Audio's preorder page says so before the price: the ship date sits above the button, not in the fine print. Preorder for $249 is a Shopify cart permalink. It opens the store checkout with one pair already in the cart, and the page itself carries no form.
fields.tab_content_3:
$12 a month beside $96 a year

Monthly subscribers see a banner inside Quoral, the notes app, and it opens a page with the two prices side by side. Twelve months at $12 come to $144, which makes the $96 annual plan $48 cheaper. Switch to annual opens Quoral's billing page with the annual plan selected, and the subscriber only confirms.
fields.tab_content_4:
Which of 3 buttons drew 121 clicks?

Ferrowood Piano tested where the button goes on its course page by placing the same Enroll for $79 button in 3 places. Of 223 clicks this month, 38 came from the top of the page, 121 from the button after the syllabus, and 64 from the one after the FAQ. The syllabus section keeps its button.

fields.howto_title: How to Build a Click Through Landing Page
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to a click through landing page that warms visitors up and hands them to checkout or signup, built with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Pick the one page the button opens
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Write the warm-up before the button
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Tag every link that brings traffic in
fields.howto_step_1_des: Choose a single destination, such as a trial signup or a store checkout, never both. A second button to a different place splits the clicks, and the page can no longer tell you which offer worked. Keep any other links in the footer.
fields.howto_step_2_des: List what a visitor needs to know before paying or signing up: what it does, what it costs, when it arrives. Answer each point above the button, in the order a buyer would ask, and cut any section that answers nothing.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Write down what the next page should already know: the plan, the item and quantity, or a coupon code. Then check that your checkout or signup accepts those values in its link before you build the page around them.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Add utm_source, utm_medium, and utm_campaign to each email, post, and partner link that points at the page. Google's Analytics help says to always use all three, and that parameter values are case sensitive. Pick one spelling per source.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Prompt with the offer and the button's destination URL, parameters included. Emergent builds the page and the click log behind it. Ask for changes in plain words, such as moving the button below the price table.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Test the hand-off with real clicks
fields.howto_step_6_des: Open the page from a tagged test link on a phone and on a laptop, then press the button. Confirm the checkout holds the right item and quantity, the signup shows the chosen plan, and the tags reach the next page.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Read the click log after a week
fields.howto_step_7_des: Compare clicks with visitors for each button placement once a week of traffic has come in. Move or remove a button that nobody presses, and change one thing at a time so the next week's numbers point at a single cause.

faq_plan.q: What is a click through landing page?
faq_plan.a: A click through landing page explains one offer, then hands the visitor to another page to buy or sign up. Unbounce describes it as having a simple button as the call to action that sends the visitor into the checkout flow, where a lead gen page would have a form.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a click through landing page?
faq_plan.a: Decide where the button goes and what its link should carry, such as the chosen plan or the item for the cart. Then describe the offer and its destination to Emergent's AI landing page builder, which builds the page and a log of every click. Press the button on a phone before any traffic arrives.

faq_plan.q: How is a click through landing page different from one with a signup form?
faq_plan.a: The difference is where the visitor acts. A click through page has no form of its own: its button opens another page, and the signup or purchase happens there. Unbounce says lead gen pages, which it also calls squeeze pages, use a form as their call to action, and that form collects the details on the page itself.

faq_plan.q: Where should the button go on a click through landing page?
faq_plan.a: Put the first button right after the section that answers the visitor's main question, then repeat the same button lower down with the same label and destination. On a mobile landing page, keep one button on screen without scrolling and make it wide enough to press with a thumb.

faq_plan.q: What should a click through landing page pass to the checkout page?
faq_plan.a: Pass whatever the visitor has already chosen on the page: the tier they clicked, the product and how many, any discount code. On a Shopify store, a cart permalink that sends the customer to a checkout with the selected merchandise is the default, and the same link creates a new checkout for each customer.

faq_plan.q: How do I track which campaign a click through landing page visitor came from?
faq_plan.a: Log each button click with the campaign tags the visitor arrived with, then match those tags against the signups on the next page. Compare the two per campaign each week. An app built with Emergent keeps that click log in a database you own.

faq_plan.q: Can a click through landing page include a video?
faq_plan.a: Yes. A short demo above the button can show what a screenshot cannot, as long as the button sits beside it and does not wait for the video to end. A page built around the video itself is a video landing page, which has its own layout and playback choices.

faq_plan.q: Should a click through landing page show the price before checkout?
faq_plan.a: Yes, when the next page asks for payment. A visitor who meets the price for the first time at checkout has to decide all over again, while one who read it on the page has already decided. For a free trial, say what happens to the account when the trial ends.

faq_plan.q: Can a click through landing page send visitors to a free trial?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Unbounce counts signup landing pages as one form of click through page. They ask visitors to take a first step by signing up for a free trial or subscription. Carry the chosen plan into the signup link so the visitor does not pick it twice.

faq_plan.q: Can a click through landing page work from a printed flyer?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Print a QR code that opens the page, and give that link its own utm_campaign value so scans show up apart from email visits. A qr code landing page covers the scan side in more depth. Emergent is free to start, and the free tier covers building and publishing.

plan.angle: The top 10 for click through landing page is example galleries and one-paragraph definitions: a page with a button and no form. None of them shows the hand-off, which is the whole job: what the button carries into the checkout or signup, and how you know the page warmed anyone up. This page shows four click-through pages with the destination drawn (a trial signup, a preorder checkout, an annual billing switch, a course enrollment), gives the build rules the galleries skip (one destination, the offer and campaign tags carried in the link, clicks counted per button), and keeps email capture, multi-step funnels and ad-group matching on their sibling pages.
